faq.q: What is the origin of Baki?
faq.a: Baki is associated with Arabic. Bāqī ('remaining, everlasting'); al-Bāqī is one of the divine names. The source record's gloss 'Fed, nourished' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form باقي is Arabic.
Baki can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
